name: Zoar

description: The small town Lot fled to for refuge when Sodom and Gomorrah were destroyed, spared at his request because of its smallness (Genesis 19:20-23) — before Lot left it too, fearful, for a cave in the nearby hills.
family_friendly_summary: Zoar was a small town that Lot ran to for safety when God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah. Lot begged the angels to spare it because it was so little, and they did. Later, Lot became afraid to stay even there and moved up into a cave in the hills.
